Record Labs 2.0.3

- Liquid Glass Material (Settings > Appearance): the navigation bar, mini player, menus, dialogs, search suggestions and the player's corner buttons in clear, stretchy glass that lights up under your finger
- Pages open and close with iOS-style transitions; album pages now open at the top
- The app fills the whole screen with the white gesture bar (no more dark strip at the bottom)
- With the keyboard open, the navigation bar and mini player stay in place and search suggestions end above the keyboard
- Lyrics: the pronunciation of Japanese, Korean, Chinese and other scripts now sits under each word, as in Apple Music; smoother scrolling; lines closer together in portrait; tapping the lyrics on the player opens the lyrics page
- Home is made more from your own listening: Keep listening, "Because you listened to…", Daily discover, More from your top artists and Rediscover your likes, right after Quick picks
- Autoplay picks a different queue each time you play the same song
- Moving songs in the queue is smooth: hold a song near the top or bottom and the queue scrolls along
- Record Labs Connect: switching from a PC to the phone works reliably, both devices stay in sync, the phone shows the playing device's name, and the music video version follows to the other device
- Listen Together: an approved suggestion plays after the current song (and songs added before it); with guest playback controls on, listeners can play, queue and arrange songs like the host
- Landscape: the lyrics page responds to taps again, and the corner buttons stay with the queue open
- Fixes: songs shown as by "YouTube Music", a different song playing than the one tapped, lyrics failing to load, and the mini player's corners when switching between rounded and square
